title.narrative: Multitranche Financing Facility (MFF) - Assam Integrated Flood and Riverbank Erosion Risk Management Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: The components for financing under the Project are (i) development of flood and riverbank erosion risk management (FRERM) planning, institutional and knowledge bases, (ii)establishment of comprehensive FRERM systems (in particular, the Project will support the priority interventions to strengthen the FRERM systems of the 3 subproject area, viz., Dibrugarh in Dibrugarh district, Kaziranga in Golaghat district, and Palasbari-Gumi in Kamrup district), and (iii) provision of multidisciplinary project management systems.

title.narrative: Loan 2684: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Progress Toward Outcome: Activities under Project 1 have been completed. Achievement towards outcome will be assessed at facility completion report preparation.
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Sep 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/38412/38412-023-smr-en_9.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: A. State water policy has been formulated. FRERM systems have been established and will be continued in Project 2.
B. FRERM program is being implemented in the project areas and will continue to be enhanced during Project 2.
C. Capacity development of FRERM institutions were undertaken.
